Ghost of Yotei – PS5 vs PS5 Pro Graphics Showdown


After a year of hype, Sucker Punch has finally dropped Ghost of Yotei, the follow-up to Ghost of Tsushima. With both the base PS5 and beefed-up PS5 Pro in play—each offering multiple graphics modes—you’ve got to wonder which rig gives you the prettiest, smoothest ride through snowy volcanic peaks.

The Thing with Feathers – Official Trailer (2025)


After his wife’s sudden death, a single dad (Benedict Cumberbatch) is left juggling two young sons and an ever-growing pile of grief that’s anything but tidy. Just when life seems impossibly chaotic, an unhinged house guest called Crow starts popping up in the shadows, taunting him at every turn.
As his world spirals out of control, Crow’s eerie antics might be the very thing this broken family needs to face their pain head-on—and maybe even find a strange form of healing in the madness.

Xbox Game Pass Just Got a Hefty Bump

Xbox has quietly slapped its Ultimate Game Pass tier with a 50% price hike—from $19.99 to $29.99 (about 53% in the U.K.)—marking the second increase in just over a year. The lower tiers aren’t going up in cost but are getting snazzier new names—Essential (formerly Core) and Premium (formerly Standard)—plus some extra perks. Gamers, unsurprisingly, aren’t thrilled.
Witcher Creator’s One-Regret Moment

Over in The Witcher world, author Andrzej Sapkowski publicly regrets a single line he penned in the early books that’s ballooned into a huge deal thanks to the games. Talk about unintended legacy!

articles.description:
Imagine a sudden, unexplained market plunge erasing billions in value. Now, imagine that the underlying cause was a subtle interaction between multiple AI trading systems, invisible to current monitoring tools. This isn't science fiction; it's a growing threat in today's AI-driven financial markets.
The core idea? Establishing a centralized, anonymized database of algorithmic trading incidents, analyzed across jurisdictions. Think of it like a flight recorder for high-frequency trading: capturing critical data without revealing competitive secrets or sensitive customer information.
This allows regulators and firms to proactively identify systemic risks lurking within complex algorithmic interactions. Percentage-based metrics are vital. We need to preserve ratios while obscuring exact times…
articles.title: Algorithmic Black Swans: Can We Predict the Next Flash Crash? by Arvind Sundararajan
